AITV · design system in code

AITV Design System

Version —Pulled from Figma Open the Figma library Public link (also tokens.json, ds.css, ds.js)

Every prototype carries this system inline, so colours, text styles and components come from one place. Figma is the source: when the library changes, the tokens are pulled again and every prototype is re-synced. A component designed in a prototype first lands here as "code only" until it is moved into Figma.

Colours

Semantic tokens first (03-Tokens); use these in components. The primitives below (04-Foundations) are for the rare case a token does not cover.

Text styles

All 22 local text styles of the library. Use the class on an element, or font:var(--t-…) with letter-spacing:var(--t-…-ls) inside a rule. Two weights only: Medium 500 and Regular 400.

Radius, spacing, shadows

01-Radius and 02-Spacing variables and the four effect styles.

Buttons [1.1]

.ds-btn + a style (--primary, --secondary, --lighter, --ghost), a size (--lg 56, default 40, --sm 36, --xs 32, --2xs 28), --round and --icon. Label in a <span>, icons as svg.ds-ic. "Show more" under a grid is ds-btn--lighter ds-btn--lg ds-btn--round with a label and no icons (AITV-UI 18849:404708).

Link Buttons [1.1]

.ds-link (Gray), --white, --primary; --sm for the 16px size.

Chips

.ds-chip, selected with .is-active or aria-pressed="true"; sizes like the buttons, --round. Tap the chips in the last row.

Toggle switch

<button class="ds-switch" role="switch" aria-checked="…">; DS.flip(el) turns it. The last column is live.

Segmented control

.ds-seg holding .ds-seg__items, the selected one .is-active; --round for the pill bar.

Text input

<label class="ds-field"> with an icon and an <input>; --sm, --xs; .is-error, .is-disabled. Hover and focus are live; the second row forces them. Code only .ds-field--area wraps a <textarea> (min 88 high) with the same box and states, for descriptions. Code only .ds-field--round makes the box a pill (12 in on both sides).

Tooltip

.ds-tip (one line) and .ds-tip--lg (title + description). The tail is not drawn yet.

Save video Picture in pictureKeep watching in a small window while you browse.

Radio

<span class="ds-radio"> inside the clickable row .ds-choice; on with .is-on, or aria-checked="true" on the row (role="radio"). Hovering the row hovers the radio. The last column is live.

Checkbox

<span class="ds-check">, same markup and states as the radio, plus .is-mixed (indeterminate). Used for the playlists in Save to.

Footer

.ds-footer (Desktop) or .ds-footer ds-footer--mobile: link groups (.ds-footer__title + .ds-footer__links) and the bottom bar (.ds-footer__bar with __copy and __social). How many columns the links flow into is the page's layout, not the component's.

Icons

Vuesax (the Iconsax set, page 24:425): Linear for outline icons, Bold for filled and active ones (an active nav tab, a liked heart). Remix only where Vuesax has nothing: plain close and check, brand logos, picture-in-picture, fullscreen.

Scale, never resize. Every icon is drawn on the 24 grid with a 1.5 stroke. Keep the 24 viewBox and set the size with width/height (in Figma: scale the instance with K, or set it in the instance's size), so the stroke scales with it: 1.5 at 24, 1.25 at 20, 1 at 16. Resizing the frame and its vectors keeps a 1.5 stroke at every size, which reads too heavy below 24.

One play icon: Vuesax play Linear everywhere (buttons, notices, player; pause is Linear too). No Bold or circled play.

Share is always share-fat (1546:5261, on the same page under Search), not Vuesax share: every share button, menu row and rail item.

A Linear icon is never filled. Its paths are strokes; giving them a fill turns a ring into a disc. For a filled look use the Bold variant of the same icon.

Product components Figma

The product's own components (header, cards, player, sheets, dialogs …), on the DS file's product page: 112 components with 633 variants, read from Figma on 21 Oct 2026. Figma is the source: use them as instances there, and in code build them from the DS tokens and text styles as the prototype p-4f6cb6 does. Each card links to the component in Figma; its description there has the exact values and where each variant is used.

Toggle motion Code only

DS.toggle(button, on, {on, off}) swaps a two-state button: the icon shrinks out with a light blur and grows back, the label cross-fades, the pill eases to its new width (about 250ms). Not in Figma yet.

Status

What is in code, what is still Figma only, and what started in a prototype.

Source of truth: variables only. Colours come from the variable collections (04-Foundations primitives, 03-Tokens semantics, 01-Radius, 02-Spacing). The file still holds 40 legacy colour styles (Primary/Dark, Background/…, Text/…, Alpha/…); nothing here is taken from them.

Left to clean up in Figma (checked 11 Oct 2026; code already uses the variable value)

  • Text Input: "Sublabel text" uses the legacy style Text/Secondary (#a3a3a3) instead of the variable text/secondary (#adafb2).
  • ToggleSwitch: a hidden 4×4 dot uses the legacy style Background/200; the thumb shadow is a raw value, not an effect style.
  • Text Input and Segmented Control use effect styles from another library (regular-shadow/x-small, components/toggle/switch, …/important-focus, …/error-focus), not the DS shadows.
  • Tooltip shadow is a raw value (0 2 6 black 51%), not a DS effect style.
  • Radio and Checkbox, Disabled + On: the dot / check (text/disabled) and the control (icon/disabled) are both neutral/600, so the mark disappears. Proposal: the mark on text/tertiary, or the control on neutral/700.
  • Radio and Checkbox shadow (0 2 2 rgba(27,28,29,.12)) is a raw value, not a DS effect style.
  • Footer: hidden "FAQs" text layers use Fonts/Content/fontSubTitle, a style from another library.
  • Icons: the Vuesax page is still named "[OLD]" although it is the set in use, and several icons share a name (more than one "arrow-left"); the chevrons are arrow-left-2… in Iconsax. Proposal: rename the page and give the duplicates their Iconsax names.
  • Icons: use only Vuesax play Linear (Play Bold 595:1151 reads odd small) and share-fat (1546:5261) for share.
  • Missing in the library, still drawn by the prototype: underline Tabs, a glass button for video overlays, the header search field's open states.
  • Icons: the Vuesax Linear archive (bookmark with the curve, Library / Save) is the component named frame (26:9934, inside the "Archive" frame 26:9876); Bold is bold/archive (595:2803). Proposal: rename frame to archive so it can be found by name. Search is search-normal (26:7870) everywhere, prototype included.
  • Buttons: Large (56) + Rounded=Yes was missing; added to Buttons [1.1] on 11 Oct (24 variants, radius bound to radius-full). Publish the library, then "Show more" in AITV-UI can use it instead of the radius 999 override.
  • Footer: the link lists are fixed slots (e.g. Genres has 14), so the full list (Romance, Thriller…) does not fit; the links are data and should flow from it.

How prototypes use it

Each prototype stays a single file. tools/ds_sync.py copies this system into it between /* ds:begin */ and /* ds:end */ (CSS) and in <script id="ds-js"> (behaviour), and stamps the version.

Figma → code. Pull the library into ds/tokens.json, update ds/components.css for changed components, run tools/ds_build.py, then tools/ds_sync.py --all, and check every prototype.

Code → Figma. A component a prototype needs and the library lacks is added here as "Code only". When it is approved it is built in Figma from the library's variables, text styles and component states, and its status turns to "In both".
